description: VPIC_DIST extracts particle-distribution functions for selected regions from VPIC simulation data. It provides three-dimensional or reduced distribution summaries for subsequent analysis. The resource is documented by Dartmouth University. The documented physical domain is Geospace, Local Physics; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Runs-on-Request. A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. The documented tool only supports particle output from the 2016 VPIC model version. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. The cited documentation is available online; underlying files were not downloaded. Spatial and temporal resolution were not independently established.
